ammonia.reason: No surface flora or prolonged proteolysis/deamination in fresh <12h cheese.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk, no p-cresol/indole reported in Burrata volatilome.

bitter.reason: Very low proteolysis and hydrophobic peptides in fresh rennet curd, low salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium, 2-heptanone n.d. day-1 and no C7-C11 methyl ketones.

browning.reason: High lactose/moisture gives moderate Maillard browning on heating despite no aging.

buttery.reason: Citrate fermentation by starters yields diacetyl 84.7 ug/100g + acetoin 202.6 ug/100g in cream.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very limited lipolysis fresh: only 120.5 ug/100g butanoic acid, hexanoic n.d. in control.

creaminess.reason: 70% moisture stracciatella + cream filling gives fluid fat-in-water emulsion.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic stretched pouch plus liquid cream, no crumbly demineralized body.

firmness.reason: Very high moisture 70.01% and pH 6.29 with minimal acid firming, thin pouch.

floral_honey.reason: No phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol reported; only faint milky lactones.

fruity.reason: Esterase activity minimal fresh; ethyl butanoate/hexanoate not found, only trace ethyl acetate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat without caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: No aged Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal or propanal reported in fresh curd.

melt.reason: Low-calcium stretched mozzarella shell flows, cream filling liquefies on warming.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not found, no mold linoleate oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat 17.9% in stable cream emulsion, little free oil when fresh.

smoky.reason: Not smoked, guaiacol not found in volatilome.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid n.d., pH 6.29 and 0.28% lactic acid, minimal vinegar sharpness.

stretch.reason: Hot-water pasta-filata alignment of paracasein gives extensible outer pouch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurized milk plus hot stretch gives only faint whey-protein H2S/dimethyl sulfide.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose plus cream and diacetyl sweetness, very low NaCl 0.42% and low acid.

umami.reason: No aging proteolysis to glutamate; fresh casein intact, low total N.
